title: A giant spin molecule with ninety-six parallel unpaired electrons

synthesis.procedure: Gd(NO3)3·5H2O, Cr(acac)3, N-methyldiethanolamine, deionized water, triethylamine, and acetonitrile were sealed in a 12 mL glass vial and heated at 130 °C under autogenous pressure for three days. Dark-green needle-like crystals were isolated and washed with acetonitrile. The procedure appears in the Supplemental Experimental Procedures embedded in the supplied Markdown, not in the main article's METHODS section.
synthesis.vessel_or_method: Sealed 12 mL glass vial; autogenous pressure
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Dark-green needle-like crystals isolated and washed with acetonitrile

properties.summary: Ferrimagnetic Cr10Gd18 cage with a reported ground spin state of S = 48. Pulsed-field magnetization shows a low-field plateau followed by a fully aligned state; static-field measurements at 0.5 K show no hysteresis.

list_of_rare_earth_compounds.structure_description: A dumbbell-shaped cage comprising two Cr5Gd6 end units joined by three linear Gd2 units; the architecture is described using 1-Gd in Figure 1 and Results and Discussion.

synthesis.procedure: The 1-Gd procedure was followed, replacing Gd(NO3)3·5H2O with Dy(NO3)3·5H2O. The shared mixture was sealed in a 12 mL glass vial, heated at 130 °C under autogenous pressure for three days, and the crystals were isolated and washed with acetonitrile. This procedure appears in the Supplemental Experimental Procedures embedded in the supplied Markdown.

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Crystals isolated and washed with acetonitrile, following the shared procedure
